title: Forest Heraldic Scene
description: A detailed heraldic illustration featuring a blue shield with two golden pinecones and a white lily, topped by a helmeted mouse knight. Below and around the shield, an army of armored mouse knights ride elephants through a field of purple lavender and red poppies, with decorative pink and yellow foliage framing the composition. A golden banner on the right reads 'FORGET'.
prompt: Heraldic scene with a blue shield displaying two large golden pinecones and a white lily at its base, surmounted by a helmeted brown mouse knight. Armored mouse knights riding brown elephants march across a field of purple lavender and red poppies. Ornate pink and yellow foliage frames the composition against a cloudy sky. A golden banner on the right side reads 'FORGET' in black letters, whimsical fantasy style, rich colors, detailed illustration.
